S03.meta: // SLIDE 03 — GETTING INTO BLOOD: From millions shed to fewer than 1-in-10,000 forming a colony

data.startLabel: Cancer cells shed into circulation per day

stages.label: Survive transit (shear stress, NK cell killing, anoikis)
Avoid dormancy induction and immune clearance
Establish a viable, proliferating metastatic colony

data.endClaim: Fewer than 1 in 10,000 circulating tumor cells ever forms a metastatic colony — each step is a bottleneck

S05.meta: // SLIDE 05 — WHY CLUSTERS ARE THE THREAT: Single CTC vs CTC cluster

data.splitLabel: Single cell vs cluster of 2–5 cells

tracks.label: Single circulating tumor cell
tracks.outcome: Rarely survives: shear stress, anoikis, NK-cell killing eliminate most
notes: Exposed on all surfaces to immune surveillance
Mechanical shear stress causes membrane damage
NK cells patrol circulation and kill isolated CTCs

tracks.label: CTC cluster (2–5 cells)
tracks.outcome: 50-fold more likely to form metastasis than single cells
notes: Inner cells shielded from shear stress by outer layer
Cluster retains partial epithelial program — aids re-anchoring
Collective extravasation initiates a larger seeding event
50× higher metastatic efficiency vs single CTCs

S07.meta: // SLIDE 07 — PRE-METASTATIC NICHE: Does metastasis wait for the cancer cell, or does the organ prepare in advance?

data.question: Does metastasis require only the arriving cancer cell, or does the distant organ prepare in advance?

branches.label: Passive model: cancer cell arrives and adapts
branches.detail: Circulating tumor cell reaches a distant organ and, if conditions happen to be permissive, implants and grows
branches.fix: Metastasis is stochastic — right cell meets right organ by chance; no pre-conditioning required

branches.label: Active model: tumor pre-conditions the niche
branches.detail: Primary tumor secretes factors (VEGF, PlGF, LOX, exosomes) that recruit bone marrow-derived myeloid cells to specific distant organ sites before any cancer cell arrives
branches.fix: Pre-metastatic niche is established — altered inflammation, permeability, and growth factor signaling makes the organ receptive; cancer cells arrive into prepared soil

resolver.label: Tumor-secreted factors arrive at the distant organ before the cancer cell does
resolver.detail: The pre-metastatic niche explains Paget's seed-and-soil organ tropism: breast cancer preferentially seeds bone, lung, liver, and brain because those organs are pre-conditioned by breast-tumor-derived signals — not because cancer cells randomly land there
